headline: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute reason for their dismissal
summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers are disputing their dismissals, saying in an open letter that they were let go for prioritizing safety and warning of a chilling effect on staff. OpenAI maintains the researchers were fired for mishandling sensitive information after an investigation found a significant breach of trust.
